requirement.description: The AsyncResultBuilder._send method incorrectly raises exceptions directly from Result.__await__ instead of properly handling them as exceptions that should be wrapped in Error results. This causes "TypeError: exceptions must derive from BaseException" when trying to yield Error instances.
requirement.contract: When an Error result is yielded in an async context, it should be caught and converted to a proper Error result, not raise the underlying exception directly. The _send method should properly handle exceptions from awaitable Results.

requirement.description: The AsyncResultBuilder._send method has incorrect handling of StopIteration and StopAsyncIteration exceptions that causes "Task got bad yield" errors when processing async generators.
requirement.contract: StopIteration and StopAsyncIteration exceptions should be properly caught and handled to return appropriate values (either through zero() or return_ methods) instead of propagating up as runtime errors.

requirement.description: The AsyncResultBuilder._send method has incorrect handling of awaitable values that leads to "coroutine raised StopIteration" errors when dealing with async generators.
requirement.contract: Awaitable values should be properly awaited and handled, ensuring that StopIteration exceptions from the await process are correctly translated to appropriate result states.
